routes.label: Bisected angles and the triangle angle sum

question: Given \(AB\parallel CD\), line \(EF\) intersects \(AB\) at point \(E\) and \(CD\) at point \(F\). Points \(A\) and \(D\) lie on the same side of line \(EF\). Line \(EG\) bisects \(\angle AEF\), line \(FG\) bisects \(\angle EFD\), and \(EG\) and \(FG\) intersect at point \(G\). Find the measure of \(\angle G\) in degrees.
solution: Since \(AB\parallel CD\), \(\angle AEF+\angle EFD=180^\circ\). The two angle bisectors give \(\angle GEF+\angle GFE=90^\circ\), so \(\angle G=180^\circ-90^\circ=90^\circ\).
